title: IES_Policy publication envelope (proposed)
description: Proposed additive wrapper carrying who published an IES_Policy, in which currency, which earlier version it replaces, and a signature over all of it. It does not modify IES_Policy: the `policy` member is the upstream IES_Policy object exactly as published, validated separately against the upstream schema.

policy.description: An IES_Policy object, unmodified. Only its type is checked here; its own fields are governed by the upstream IES_Policy schema.

issuer.description: did:web identifier of the publishing authority. The verification key is resolved from this DID's document, never taken from the envelope.

replaces.description: The `id` (not the `policyID`) of the policy version this one amends; null on first publication.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency every price in `policy` is denominated in. One value per policy.

type.description: Signature scheme label. The reference implementation uses 'Ed25519-JCS-envelope': Ed25519 over a JSON-canonicalised form of { policy, publication } with proofValue omitted.

verificationMethod.description: DID URL of the key inside the issuer's DID document.
